# input-validator
> Rule-string validation engine ("required|number|min:18"), nested object schemas, array item validation, custom rules, and full error collection with field paths. Zero runtime dependencies.

A rule-string validation engine for TypeScript/Node — Laravel-style rule strings (`"required|number|min:18|max:120"`), nested object schemas, array item validation, custom rule registration, and full error collection (not

## API
- `RuleFn`
- `ValidationError`
- `ValidationResult`
- `FieldSchema`
- `Schema`
- `registerRule`
- `validate`
- `InputValidator`
